name: Ilevan Scanning
intro: 3D tours and marketing plans for listings, and schematic plans for renovations and additions. Every marketing plan and schematic plan is drafted by a Drexel-trained architectural designer.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.includes: Branded Realsee LiDAR tour + custom-drafted marketing plan

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.includes: Everything in Basic and Pro: both tours, the Zillow plan and the marketing plan

pricingNote: The first invoice includes the first month of hosting. Zillow plans and marketing plans are approximate and for marketing purposes only.

compare.heading: Zillow tour or branded tour?
compare.intro: Both are walkable 3D tours. The difference is whose name is on them, and where they work best.

options.title: Zillow 3D tour
points: Built for your Zillow listing, where it sits alongside the photos, with a Zillow plan generated from the tour.
Zillow is a residential marketplace, so the tour suits homes rather than commercial or mixed-use space.
Plays in Zillow's viewer, with Zillow's look and branding. There's no room for your logo or contact details.
Shareable by link, but every view runs on Zillow's platform and is presented their way.

options.title: Branded Realsee tour
points: Carries your branding, so the tour markets you wherever it's shared.
Embed it on your own website, or send it by text, email and social with no Zillow page around it.
Works for any property, from a rowhouse to commercial and mixed-use buildings.
Captured with a LiDAR scanner, which measures each room as it scans, and comes with a marketing plan drafted from it.
Stays live for as long as hosting continues.

compare.both: Complete gets you both: the Zillow tour for your Zillow listing, and the branded tour for everywhere else.

plans.heading: Schematic plans
plans.intro: More than a virtual tour. The same scan becomes a schematic plan of the building as it stands, ready for a renovation, an addition, or an architect to design from.
plans.name: Existing conditions
plans.includes: A dimensioned schematic plan of every level, drawn from the scan.

addons.name: Elevations & sections
addons.text: Exterior elevations and building sections, drawn from the same scan.

addons.name: Proposed layout
addons.text: A schematic plan of proposed changes, such as a new layout or an addition, to work out and price the job.

plans.note: Schematic plans are for planning and discussion. They are not construction documents and are not prepared by a licensed architect. Verify dimensions on site before building.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Send the address, the square footage, and the package you want.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: We scan the property room by room. A typical rowhouse takes about 45 minutes on site.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Your tour link and your Zillow, marketing or schematic plan arrive by email.

workIntro: Recent tours, marketing plans and schematic plans.
about: Every marketing plan and schematic plan is drafted by a Drexel-trained architectural designer, not generated automatically from the scan.
